episodes.synopsis: Pro wrestler Animal Mask is summoned to another world during the middle of his last bout, and decides to spread his love of animals there.
episodes.title: Wrestler x Summoning

episodes.synopsis: To open the pet shop of his dreams, Animal Mask needs money. And to get it, he'll have to fight monsters, some of whom aren't even animals!
episodes.title: Quest x Demon Beast Killer

episodes.synopsis: Animal Mask investigates a mysterious attacker who's draining blood from the townspeople.
episodes.title: Runaway Girl x Attacker

episodes.synopsis: Animal Mask is broke! To make money, he and the others will have to get part-time jobs, but none of them are cut out for working life...
episodes.title: Demon Beast x Part-Time Job

episodes.synopsis: MAO, Animal Mask's long-time rival, becomes badly depressed after his opponent disappears. But one day, he gets an opportunity for revenge...
episodes.title: Animal Mask x MAO

episodes.synopsis: Carmilla is a loser who can't do anything right. But when a rival clan challenges her, she rises to the occasion.
episodes.title: Loser x Master

episodes.synopsis: A lizardman girl wants to learn how to hunt from Animal Mask. But he's a wrestler, not a hunter, and he has very different ideas about what to teach her...
episodes.title: First Student x Pain in the Butt

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a wrestling event! For the first time in his new world, Genzo teaches everyone the joys of rivalry, drama, and wrestling!
episodes.title: Animal x Event

episodes.synopsis: The princess tracks down Genzo and demands that he go to fight the Demon King. But Genzo has other ideas, and these ideas include repeatedly suplexing her even when she's wearing a dress...
episodes.title: Princess x Panties

episodes.synopsis: The Demon King from another world carves a path of destruction across the land in search of Genzo.
episodes.title: Money x Bonds

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the main event! A knock-down drag-out brawl between the Demon King's forces and Genzo! Who will win?
episodes.title: Pride x Loyalty

episodes.synopsis: The last battle between the Demon King and the hero begins, to decide who will win the wrestling tournament.
episodes.title: Hero x Demon King
